[[Cold Storage]] }} '''Fight in a Cold Climate''' (Japanese: '''VS バニプッチ''' ''VS Vanillite''), titled '''VS Vanillite''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 491st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 31st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}.
